primary.title: ₹20,000 extra every month: Why paying off your personal loan first may win over an SIP
primary.summary: With a ₹20,000 monthly raise, borrowers must choose between repaying a personal loan or investing in mutual funds. Clearing a high-interest loan first can save more in interest and result in a larger investment corpus compared to investing the entire amount monthly.
